cohort: The study included women 15-44 years of age hospitalized for acute respiratory diseases in Moscow, Russian Federation.
finding: Pregnant women are at increased risk for hospitalization due to influenza irrespective of season, circulating viruses, or trimester.
mod_finding: Frequencies of caesarean delivery did not significantly differ between influenza-positive and influenza-negative hospitalized pregnant women or between influenza subtypes/lineages.
cross-section timing: Data collected during four seasons between 2012/2013 and 2015/2016.
